people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
translations.bsb: “Swear to me,” Jacob said. So Joseph swore to him, and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
translations.kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
translations.asv: And he said, Swear unto me: and he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
